statBlock.name: Animated Broom
statBlock.description: An enchanted broom can dart through the air to defend the place it usually sweeps.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned.
sections.Traits: Flyby. Flying out of an enemy's reach does not provoke an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack roll, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Mage Apprentice
statBlock.description: A novice spellcaster with a few practiced spells, whether learned from a mentor or discovered alone.

sections.Actions:
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged attack roll, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. On a hit, deal 14 (2d10 + 3) force damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action. Use Intelligence, with spell save DC 13 and +5 to hit on spell attacks.
At will. Mage Hand and Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Disguise Self, Ice Knife, Mage Armor (included in AC), and Thunderwave.

statBlock.name: Noble Prodigy
statBlock.description: A noble whose inherited magic may be the best-kept secret in the family.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Beguiling Strike attacks.
Beguiling Strike. Melee or ranged attack roll, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. On a hit, deal 18 (4d6 + 4) psychic damage and leave the target Charmed until the start of the noble's next turn.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action without Material components. Use Charisma, with spell save DC 16.
At will. Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand, and Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Befuddlement, Detect Thoughts, Fly, Scrying, and Shatter cast at level 7.
sections.Reactions: Shield (2/day). Cast Shield in response to its usual trigger, using Charisma as in Spellcasting.

statBlock.name: Performer
statBlock.description: A local entertainer, traveling storyteller, or musician earning a name for themselves.

sections.Actions: Shortsword. Melee attack roll, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attack roll hits the performer, halve the damage the performer takes from that attack. Round down.

statBlock.name: Performer Legend
statBlock.description: A celebrated artist whose signature act can make an audience fear or adore them.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bejeweled Baton attacks.
Bejeweled Baton. Melee attack roll, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Majestic Song. Center a 20-ft.-radius Sphere on a point within 120 ft. Every creature in it makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failed save, take 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and become Charmed or Frightened, as the performer chooses, until the end of the performer's next turn. On a successful save, take half damage and suffer no condition.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action without Material components. Use Charisma, with spell save DC 17.
At will. Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, and Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Major Image and Project Image.
sections.Reactions: Warding Charm. When a creature hits the performer with an attack roll, that creature makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failed save, the attack misses and the attacker is Charmed until the end of the performer's next turn.

statBlock.name: Performer Maestro
statBlock.description: A headliner whose performance can charm a room or stop a fight.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rapier attacks.
Rapier. Melee attack roll, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Beguiling Song. Center a 20-ft.-radius Sphere on a point within 120 ft. Every creature in it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failed save, take 20 (3d10 + 4) psychic damage and become Charmed until the end of the performer's next turn. On a successful save, take half damage and suffer no condition.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action without Material components. Use Charisma, with spell save DC 15.
At will. Minor Illusion and Prestidigitation.
1/day. Tasha's Hideous Laughter cast at level 3.

statBlock.name: Goblin Hexer
statBlock.description: A goblin spellcaster who puts on an archmage's airs and uses magic to disrupt enemies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hex Stick attacks. Replace either attack with one use of Spellcasting if desired.
Hex Stick. Melee or ranged attack roll, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. On a hit, deal 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action, or in place of one attack during Multiattack. Use Intelligence, with spell save DC 13.
At will. Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Blindness/Deafness, Faerie Fire, and Grease.
sections.Reactions: Jinx. When a creature the goblin can see hits it with an attack roll, the attacker makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failed save, the attack misses.
